verdict.rationale: Cloudflare markets itself as lock‑in free ("Fits into your existing workflows... No proprietary tools or vendor lock-in" – cloudflare-docs-17), but there is no evidence of concrete open-format export tooling for its proprietary data stores, and a hands-on community report explicitly contradicts the no-lock-in claim: "those locked-in things (KV, D1, etc.) always made it hard to switch... being able to run the same code on your own stuff or a small VPS without changing the storage is a huge dev experience boost" (cloudflare-comm-10). missing for 10: documented export/migration commands for D1, KV, R2 to standard open formats, and independent confirmation that data can be freely migrated off-platform.
